user.title: Add a Zemismart remote
user.description: Learn the remote automatically, or use an Advanced setup method. You will add its covers (blinds and groups) next.

learn_setup.title: Set up remote learning
learn_setup.description: Choose where this remote is located and which online RF bridge should capture it.

data_description.bridge: Automatic matches the selected area, then the configured default, then the first online bridge. Choose a named online bridge to override it.

learn_unavailable.title: Remote learning is unavailable
learn_unavailable.description: No online RF bridge could be discovered through MQTT. Check MQTT and bridge availability, try again, or continue with Advanced setup.

learn_next.title: Button captured
learn_next.description: Measured so far: {measured}. Choose Capture {action}, then press {action} on the remote while the bridge listens. Every action is measured from its own press: the command bytes for Up, Down, and Stop are not related the same way on every remote, so calculating one from another can produce a command your motor ignores.

menu_options.learn_derive: Skip the rest and calculate them

learn_timeout.title: No press was detected
learn_timeout.description: Press {action} on the remote during the capture window. If this remote has no {action} button the wizard can hear, the remaining bases can be calculated from what was already measured — they may be wrong for your remote, so test them afterwards.

learn_confirm.title: Confirm the detected remote
learn_confirm.description: Detected prefix {prefix}, remote ID {remote_id}, and channels {channels} for {name} through {bridge}. Measured from a real press: {measured}. Calculated rather than measured: {derived}. A calculated base can be wrong for remotes outside the common command layout — test those actions, and correct them under Edit remote settings if a blind does not respond.

advanced.title: Advanced setup
advanced.description: Choose how to provide a calibrated remote identity.

manual.title: Enter a remote manually
manual.description: Provide the remote identity and either one labeled action base or a captured B0/B1 reference.

data_description.calibration_base: Provide this or a captured reference, not both.
data_description.calibration_frame: The captured identity must match the entered prefix and remote ID.

data_description.repeats: How many times the full button press is retransmitted on air. Each transmission is already a complete OEM press burst, so this multiplies whole presses, not individual frames. More repeats improve reliability for distant or obstructed blinds, but they lengthen the interval in which a physical remote press near a just-issued command goes unrecognised as a takeover: about 9.5 s at the default 3, about 26.5 s at the maximum 20. Several blinds moving at once through one bridge extend that further.
data_description.coalesce_window_ms: Near-simultaneous commands for blinds on this remote merge into one group frame within this window. 0 disables coalescing.

cover.title: Add a cover
cover.description: Cover {count} so far. Name this blind or group and enter its channels.

data_description.channels: Use 1 for one blind, or a comma-separated group such as 1,2,3.
data_description.travel_up: Required for a blind; leave empty only for a group that contains covers you already added.
data_description.travel_down: Required for a blind; leave empty only for a group that contains covers you already added.

cover_remove_confirm.title: Remove cover
cover_remove_confirm.description: Remove {name} ({cover_id})? Its entity registry row and stored configuration will be deleted.

cover_measure_setup.title: Measure travel time
cover_measure_setup.description: Pick the bridge that will listen while you run {name} with its remote. Automatic uses the bridge for this device's area.

cover_measure_next.title: {measured} measured
cover_measure_next.description:
{measured} took {seconds} s, which will be stored as {stored} s.

Now press {wanted} on the remote, then press STOP the moment the shade stops moving.

cover_measure_timeout.title: Nothing measured
cover_measure_timeout.description:
The run did not complete ({reason}). Check that the remote drives this shade's channels, that you are in range of the bridge, and that you press STOP after the shade stops moving.

A remote created by the new_virtual_remote service cannot be measured this way, because no physical remote transmits its identity.

cover_measure_confirm.title: Confirm travel times for {name}
cover_measure_confirm.description:
Measured: down {down} s, up {up} s. Stored values are rounded up, because pressing STOP after the shade arrives always measures a little long and a generous time simply stalls the motor at its own limit.

Correct either value before saving.

error.invalid_config: Check the remote identity, calibration, channel set, travel times, area, and Advanced settings.
error.bridge_unavailable: Choose a bridge that was discovered as online.
error.already_configured: This remote is already configured by another entry.
error.travel_required: Enter both travel times — only a group containing existing covers can omit them.
error.duplicate_channels: Another cover of this remote already uses exactly these channels.
error.overlapping_channels: Channels may be fully inside, fully containing, or separate from another cover — never partially overlapping.
error.cover_not_found: Choose a cover that still exists.
error.measure_no_bridge: No bridge could be reached to listen for the remote. Enter the travel times manually.

abort.legacy_not_supported: This entry uses the old per-blind format. Delete it and add its remote again instead of reconfiguring.
abort.channel_conflict: The collected covers conflict; start over.
abort.invalid_config: The stored cover configuration is invalid and cannot be managed.
abort.cover_not_found: The selected cover no longer exists.
abort.last_cover: The last cover cannot be removed. Delete the remote entry instead.
abort.aggregate_dependency: This cover cannot be removed because an aggregate cover depends on its channels.

send_raw.name: Send raw frame
send_raw.description: Send one debug Portisch B0 frame through a specific online bridge.

bridge.name: Bridge
bridge.description: Bridge ID from the bridge's rf433 info topic.

repeats.name: Repeats
repeats.description: How many times the frame is transmitted (distant or obstructed blinds may need more).

new_virtual_remote.name: Allocate virtual remote
new_virtual_remote.description: Generate an unused remote identity with a complete synthesized calibration. The response's prefix, remote ID, and UP base go straight into the manual add-integration flow; pair the motor by sending OPEN while it is in its RF pairing mode.

reanchor.name: Re-anchor position
reanchor.description: Drive a cover (or group) to a hard endpoint and re-anchor its position estimate there. Explicit recovery only: use it after a heard STOP or a restart has left the position untrustworthy or unknown.

endpoint.name: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Which hard limit to drive to. Both the fully open and fully closed endpoints are physical stops the estimate re-anchors against; pick whichever is safer to reach right now.

no_runtime_loaded.message: No Zemismart Blinds entry is loaded, so no bridge registry exists.

send_raw_invalid_frame.message: The raw frame was rejected before transmission. See the log for the reason.

send_raw_transport_failed.message: The raw frame could not be transmitted. See the log for the reason.

legacy_entry_format.message: This entry uses the retired per-blind format. Add its remote through the integration's new wizard, then delete this entry.

command_timeout.message: The bridge did not confirm the command in time, so the position is now unknown.

command_failed.message: The command could not be sent.

position_unknown.message: The position is unknown; run a full open or close calibration first.

no_members_available.message: No member covers are available to position (unavailable: {unavailable}).

member_position_unknown.message: No frame was sent: the position is unknown for {members}. Run a full open or close calibration first.

aggregate_incomplete.message: This group's cover for channel(s) {missing} is not set up right now, so it cannot be positioned as a whole. Check that cover (a cover with no travel times is skipped at startup), or position the members individually.

no_bridge_online.message: No RF433 bridge is online, so the command could not be sent.

transport_failed.message: The command could not be handed to MQTT.

invalid_frame.message: The frame was rejected before transmission.

queue_full.message: Too many commands are already waiting for the bridge. Try again shortly.
